title: CWP/21742/2008 of RAJINDER KUMAR AND ORS. Vs STATE OF HARYANA AND ORS.
text:
206 IN THE HIGH COURT OF PUNJAB AND HARYANA AT CHANDIGARH Date of Decision:07.02.2025 RAJINDER KUMAR ANDORS. ew. Petitioners Versus STATE OF HARYANA ANDORS. —___....... Respondents CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE JAGMOHAN BANSAL Present: Mr. Jai Bhagwan Sharma, Advocate for the petitioners. Mr. Saurabh Mohunta, DAG, Haryana. sek JAGMOHAN BANSAL, J. (Oral)

1. The petitioners through instant petition filed under Articles 226/227 of the Constitution of India are seeking setting aside of impugned advertisement dated 02.11.2008 (Annexure P-1). They are further seeking direction to respondents to regularize their service.

2. The petitioners are claiming regularization. The petitioners are working as Class-[V employees with respondents. They are working for last more than three decades. They are working without interruption and interim orders of Courts.

3. On being confronted with judgment dated 26.07.2024 passed by Division Bench of this Court in LPA No.1892 of 2019 titled as ‘State of Haryana and others Vs. Jai Bhagwan’, Mr. Saurabh Mohunta, DAG, Haryana submits that case of petitioners would be considered in the light of aforesaid judgment.

4. The Division Bench in aforesaid judgment has considered 2025 PHHC 018492 claim of part time Water Carrier who were working for three decades. The petitioners herein are also working as part time Water Carrier and working for more than three decades without intervention of Courts. The respondents are directed to consider claim of petitioner in the light of aforesaid judgment. Let the needful be done within a period of six months from today.

5. Disposed of. ( JAGMOHAN BANSAL ) JUDGE 07.02.2025 Ali Asgar Ali
